description: This file defines API routes for managing tasks within a project management platform. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and deleting tasks, with appropriate authorization and database interactions.

methods.name: None _assert_project_in_org(conn, project_id: str, org_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if a project exists within an organization and raises a 404 error if not.

methods.name: Task create_task( data: TaskCreate = Body(...), ctx=Depends(require_org_role("member")), )
methods.description: Creates a new task within a project in the current organization, requiring at least member role.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks( project_id: str = Query(..., description="Filter by project ID"), ctx=Depends(require_org_role("viewer")), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks filtered by project ID within the current organization, requiring viewer role.

methods.name: Task update_task( task_id: str, data: TaskUpdate = Body(...), ctx=Depends(require_org_role("member")), )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing task, requiring member role.

methods.name: None delete_task(task_id: str, ctx=Depends(require_org_role("admin")))
methods.description: Deletes a task, requiring admin or owner role.

ctags.name: _assert_project_in_org
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_project_in_org(conn, project_id: str, org_id: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: list_tasks
ctags.signature: ( project_id: str = Query(..., description="Filter by project ID"), ctx=Depends(require_org_role("viewer")), )

ctags.name: update_task
ctags.signature: ( task_id: str, data: TaskUpdate = Body(...), ctx=Depends(require_org_role("member")), )
